# Xelorsoft

> Xelorsoft is a software studio in Kerala, India. It builds custom software, AI tools and business websites for startups and small businesses, and makes its own products for local businesses: XS Gym, XS Salon and XS Connect. All copy and support are in English; the products also speak Malayalam.

## Products

- [XS Gym](https://gym.xelorsoft.com/): gym management software for members, memberships, payments, expenses, enquiries, WhatsApp reminders and an English/Malayalam voice assistant.
- [XS Salon](https://salon.xelorsoft.com/): salon software with a stylist calendar, GST billing, clients, services, inventory, reports and an online booking link.
- [XS Connect](https://xsconnect.xelorsoft.com/): one inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook messages, with AI replies in English or Malayalam, leads and orders.

## Services

- [Custom software](https://xelorsoft.com/#services): web and mobile apps for one business workflow or a whole operation.
- [AI and automation](https://xelorsoft.com/#ai): assistants that handle repeat work such as replies, reminders and data entry.
- [Websites](https://xelorsoft.com/#web): fast business websites with contact forms, email and search listing set up.
